author: Gerd-Hendric Suhle
text:
Our safari was an absolute highlight! The driver was not only highly skilled but also had an impressive knowledge of the local wildlife and flora. What stood out the most was his keen eye for detail: he didn’t just point out the big animals like elephants and lions but also introduced us to the smaller, often overlooked creatures like chameleons, birds, and insects.

The entire atmosphere during the trip was incredibly relaxed and enjoyable. We never felt rushed, yet every moment was filled with excitement. The driver was careful and drove with great skill, allowing us to take in the surroundings in peace. His cheerful and positive demeanor added so much to the experience—it was clear that he truly loves what he does.

All in all, it was an unforgettable experience that we would gladly repeat. Thank you for such an amazing safari!

author: Jack Ryan
text: This was mine and my partners first safari and it did not disappoint. Our tour guide Nuwan’s knowledge and keen eye for both flora and fauna made this safari extra special. He was also super friendly with great English making it very easy to converse and ask questions about the spectacular animals on display such as elephants(the highlight), mongoose, eagles, spotted deer(Bambi lookalikes), monkeys, and so much more. Nuwan got us very close to the elephants while still respecting their space making it impossible not to get the perfect photograph with these special animals. I would recommend this safari with Nuwan to anybody as it has been the highlight of our time in Sri Lanka, which says a lot as it is such an amazing place!

author: Terry Denness
text: Outstanding safari experience. Found Nuwans details on the official park website and his communications were excellent and pricing fair. Excellent driving through the park and so incredibly knowledgeable about the wildlife within - especially for a young man! We saw so many elephants plus crocodiles, eagles, buffalos, many birds etc in the evening (2pm) safari. Thank you Nuwan!

author: Isabel Wünsch
text:
We went on a 10-hour safari and saw a lot. The elephants at the lake were especially amazing, and since we did the safari for so long, it was super relaxing to watch the elephants bathing without having to move on. It started to rain in the afternoon, and the roads got significantly worse until we suddenly got stuck. Unfortunately, the car didn't have four-wheel drive and couldn't get out on its own, but we were pulled out by another jeep. 

It was definitely an adventure; except for the last half hour, I would recommend everything. Nuwan is super nice, he also organized lunch, and the prices are very fair.!

author: Carolin Oertle
text:
I can just agree with the other 5-star-reviews. Nuwan was an amazing tour guide with an impressive eye and a great sense for finding elephants and other animals and was also telling us interesting fun facts about the animals. 

We did our safari in the morning for at least 3 hours and saw not just elephants (with their babies) but also crocodiles, monkeys, water buffalos, different birds etc.

It was a great experience and I would totally recommend doing a safari at Udawalawe National Park with Nuwan as guide.

author: Gaja Černe
text:
This safari tour was an amazing experience! Nuwan was like a hawk - seeing even the smallest animals that, we noticed, the other tour guides overlooked. You could see that he is very knowledgeable and interested in animals and he shared this knowledge with us.

We saw a lot of elephants, crocodiles, water buffalos, iguanas, a lot of different birds, parrots, an eagle, spotted deer and monkeys. nuwan really knows the park well and sometimes takes you off road.

He picked us up and dropped us off at the hotel. He even took pictures of us with the elephants :)

We really enjoyed our first safari ever and ee highly recommend this experience to everyone! Thank you Nuwan!
